citations.excerpt: even when we adjust the temperature down to 0 (thus making the sampling theoretically deterministic), LLM APIs are still not deterministic in practice ... the primary reason nearly all LLM inference endpoints are nondeterministic is that the load (and thus batch-size) nondeterministically varies ...
